title: 12.6 Surface Areas and Volumes of Spheres

icans: I can find the surface area of a sphere.
I can find the volume of a sphere.
I can find the surface area and volume of a hemisphere.

vocab: the set of all points in space that are the same ___________ from a given point, the center
the _______________ of a sphere and a plane that contains the center of the sphere
half of a sphere, formed when a great circle ____________ a sphere into two congruent halves

blocks.p: Measure the orange’s circumference and find its radius. Trace four circles with that radius. Peel the orange and fill the circles.
The surface area of a sphere is about ______ times πr².

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: Find the surface area of the sphere. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A sphere has a surface area of 144π square inches. Find its radius.
Find the volume of a sphere with a radius of 3 meters. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A sphere has a surface area of 64π square feet. Find its volume. Round to the nearest hundredth.

notes: Hemisphere: the volume is half the sphere’s; the surface area is half of 4πr² _______________ the flat circle, πr².

blocks.stem: Find the volume and the surface area of the hemisphere. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A ball has a diameter of 10 inches. Find its volume. Round to the nearest hundredth.
Find the surface area of a sphere with a radius of 7. Round to the nearest hundredth.
